acceptance_boundaries.publication_instruction: Publish only the reviewed files and this review to the existing PR 118; do not merge.
acceptance_boundaries.status_time_boundary: Publication and exact-source CI were pending at this immutable source-review freeze. Subsequent results require their own source and artifact attribution.

coverage: Authority injection, duplicate or ambiguous JSON, wrong types and citation equality aliases.
Plausible incorrect answers with bad provenance, scope, state or causal observations.
Rehashed transcript rewrites, task substitution and unsupported terminal failure claims.
Startup stall, process creation failure, pending model/tool kill and repeated malformed-frame reader cleanup.
Pinned-time stale salience, exact byte boundaries, diagnostic reserve exhaustion and synthetic-failure classification.
Failure-inclusive cost, undefined zero-success rates, unknown work and live/injected pooling rejection.
Actual prior wrong structured answer reaches the next model request as untrusted context and permits a grounded correction.
Typed pinned-corpus admission and strict nested verifier-version rejection.

model_feasibility_evidence.kind: Tokenizer/configuration-only feasibility, with explicitly synthetic planned actions and predecessor context.
model_feasibility_evidence.retained_findings: Nine recorded initial requests fit. A planned prior-context follow-up totals 585 tokens with reservation 128. The planned compact-reference supersession path overflows the 1024-token window by 50 at the default reservation 128; a separately labeled reservation 64 fits that one path. Actual generated history remains subject to runtime admission.

remaining_qualification_limits: No compatible provenance-bound trained snapshot or genuine trained-model semantic campaign is qualified. M7 remains open until separately frozen live acceptance evidence is independently verified.
The random tiny model demonstrates execution plumbing. Scripted tests are test_injected; lexical ranking is synthetic_fixture. Neither establishes learned retrieval or model task quality.
Scheduled related peer writes do not qualify live multi-agent concurrency. The corpus has one required model-owned supersession; other tasks have bounded read-only expectations.
Structural validation and public digests establish consistency, not producer authentication, trained provenance or verifier truth for imported artifacts.
The child deadline includes startup. Bounded cleanup and authority read, then verification/publication, follow separately; the child limit is not an end-to-end latency guarantee.
Terminal completeness assumes a surviving supervisor. Atomic CLI output does not provide durable parent-death journaling or replay.
The actual prior answer may be correct or unavailable, so a repeat-error opportunity is not guaranteed. Missing denominators and interrupted cost/effects remain unavailable.
Published exact-source CI, baseline value comparisons, recurring large campaigns, durable audit/export and release qualification retain their separate gates.

confirmed_repair_areas: Bind the complete causal model transcript, identity, tools and reservation, including prior raw assistant output and exact tool messages.
Prevent reader-thread leaks after malformed IPC; terminalize process creation failures; preserve admitted unknown work after child termination.
Require raw failure evidence for each specific terminal status and derive measured latency from the actual event sequence.
Pin retrieval and verifier effective time, and enforce exact producer/diagnostic byte budgets with bounded failure evidence.
review_iterations.reason: The candidate had unresolved source correctness and evidence gaps; it did not meet the 9.5 threshold.

additional_final_repairs_verified: Replay the actual prior structured model answer and terminal reference as explicitly untrusted follow-up context; derive verifier history from the same bound context.
Use typed canonical JSON identity for packaged corpus admission before writes; reject integer/float and boolean/integer substitutions.
Require the exact known nested verifier version and unify runtime/CLI verdicts.
Retain original raw receipt/state evidence, exact allowed final authority IDs and incomplete-evidence flags without inventing metrics.

review_scope: Strict versioned action/event/terminal contracts and immutable complete model-input binding, including untrusted prior context.
Concrete local-model episode runner with bootstrap-inclusive child deadline, nonblocking bounded IPC and ACK-before-work.
Receipt tool gateway with harness-owned scope/trust/idempotency, task allowlists, immutable complete-record CAS handles and raw/model-view separation.
Eight packaged semantic scenarios with independent typed truth, causal citations, full state and model-owned supersession checks.
Failure-inclusive outcome aggregation with known lower bounds, unknown totals/effects and unchanged dml-task-outcome-v1 semantics.
Concrete-only campaign CLI, atomic bounded no-clobber reports, actual previous-terminal handoff, package data and entry point.
Mandatory zero-skip CPU CI selection, strict maintained checks, source manifest, finite running plan and honest evidence labels.

complete_tested_source_map.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, without trailing newline

reviewed_source_identity.coverage_note: All 417 source/configuration hashes were checked for test-run stability. Direct M7 review covers the 22 publication files listed above; unchanged historical source is reused evidence rather than a claim of a fresh line-by-line audit.
reviewed_source_identity.identity_kind: Uncommitted reviewed file-content snapshot based on the parent commit; the parent commit does not contain these new changes.
reviewed_source_identity.self_exclusion: This review is the twenty-third publication file. Its own hash is excluded to avoid a recursive identity; retain that hash separately in publication evidence.

reviewer_role: Independent delegated M7 grader; production implementation owned by separate builders.
score_basis: The bounded source contract, supervised execution, receipt authority, independent semantic verification and failure-inclusive accounting satisfy the frozen source scope. Independent negative controls and unchanged-source regression evidence support acceptance. The remaining gap is explicitly separate trained-model qualification, not represented as source-test success.

validation.local_typecheck_boundary: Local mypy used --python-version 3.12 because installed NumPy 2.5.3 stubs use Python 3.12 syntax. Published CI retains its Python 3.10 and 3.11 type-check gates.
validation.overlap_notice: The focused CPU selection is contained in the full regression suite; do not add the counts.

package_smoke.evidence_attribution: Root integration validation: wheel included the corpus and CLI entry point; isolated wheel import loaded all eight scenarios and CLI help. Packaging definitions and retained manifest were independently reviewed.

validation.static_verification: Inspected retained exit codes and pass logs; independently checked their hashes against the public validation manifest.

cpu.independent_verification: Parsed retained JUnit cases and verified JUnit/log hashes against the public local-validation manifest.

full.independent_verification: Parsed retained JUnit cases and verified JUnit/log hashes against the public local-validation manifest.
